summary: Add egress_policy(tenant_id, id, class, allowed_endpoint, description, created_at, updated_at) as a new first-class policy-axis table expressing which DataClass values may egress to which client-hosted LLM endpoint patterns. The table is tenant-isolated (FORCE RLS, T-0013 invariants), deny-by-default (absence of row = egress not permitted), schema-dormant on day-1 (no runtime code reads it — enforcement is Stage-2 E5.10/T-0045). Migration 038. DataClass join axis imported from T-0033/data-classification.ts. No new TS runtime module. Seam contract frozen for T-0045 (Stage-2 runtime gate) and T-0033 (DataClass axis).
functional: FR-1 egress_policy table with 7 columns: tenant_id (uuid NOT NULL), id (uuid NOT NULL), class (text NOT NULL, DataClass CHECK), allowed_endpoint (text NOT NULL), description (text NULL), created_at (bigint NOT NULL), updated_at (bigint NOT NULL); PK(tenant_id, id); UNIQUE(tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint)
FR-2 T-0013 isolation invariants: tenant_id leading PK, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, USING/WITH CHECK tenant-isolation policy, choros_app SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only

FR-3 class CHECK constraint enumerates DataClass closed set: IN ('public','internal','confidential','restricted') — same axis as data_classification.class (T-0033); no class value outside this set accepted at DB level
FR-4 deny-by-default schema invariant: absence of a row for (class, allowed_endpoint) means egress NOT permitted; no catch-all 'allow all' row seeded for any tenant
FR-5 allowed_endpoint is a plain text endpoint pattern (e.g. base URL); no FK to secret-handle or agent_card (BYO-LLM secret custody is T-0025, out of scope)
FR-6 ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt updated with 'egress_policy' (alphabetical) in the same commit as migration 038
FR-7 no runtime code reads egress_policy on day-1 (schema-dormant); table seeded empty for dev tenant (deny-by-default is the out-of-box state)
non_functional: NF-1 cross-tenant isolation: row inserted under tenant A invisible to session bound to tenant B (FORCE RLS mechanism)
NF-2 no parallel policy store: no second egress-policy representation (config file, env var, hardcoded list) in src/; DB table is sole source of truth for the egress-policy axis
NF-4 no new npm dependency introduced by T-0041
NF-5 migration seam: only files numbered 038 (and optionally 039 for a seed split); no file numbered 032-037 or 040+ added
NF-6 frozen foundations untouched: data-classification.ts, grant-lattice.ts, grant-resolver.ts, object-handle.ts, and all pre-existing migrations byte-unchanged; tsc --noEmit passes
NF-7 schema dormancy verifiable: grep -r 'egress_policy' src/ (excluding __tests__/, migrations/, ci/) returns 0 matches in any .ts file
out_of_scope: runtime egress enforcement at agent call-time (E5.10 / T-0045) — Stage-2, parked until founder opens Stage-2
BYO-LLM secret-handle custody (T-0025 / E5.5) — endpoint text pattern, not a credential handle
UI for managing egress_policy rows (admin surfaces, frontend tasks)
endpoint-pattern matching semantics (prefix/exact/glob — Stage-2 / T-0045 design concern)
per-field egress granularity (axis is class×endpoint, not field×endpoint; field→class via T-0033)
hash-transform keyed digest mechanics (T-0118 — class/endpoint level policy, no transform coupling)
SoD constraints over egress policy rows
audit-log writer for egress_policy changes (T-0016/T-0031 are the audit mechanisms; T-0041 only stores timestamps)
adding an egress column to data_classification (T-0033 ADR §3.3 explicitly excludes this)

acceptance_criteria.text: Migration file migrations/038_egress_policy.sql exists; creates table choros.egress_policy with PK (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint), and all 7 columns from FR-1.
egress_policy has ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
Tenant-isolation policy: USING (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid) with identical WITH CHECK clause.
Cross-tenant read: a row inserted under tenant A returns 0 rows when session is bound to tenant B.
Cross-tenant write: an INSERT with tenant A's tenant_id under tenant B's session is rejected (RLS violation).
class CHECK constraint: INSERT with class = 'top_secret' is rejected; INSERT with each of 'public', 'internal', 'confidential', 'restricted' succeeds.
Logical uniqueness: a second INSERT with the same (tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint) is rejected by the UNIQUE constraint.
choros_app role has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on egress_policy and no DDL rights.
ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt contains 'egress_policy'; the cross-tenant CI tests pass for egress_policy without modification to test source.
Migration 038 is idempotent: running the migration runner twice produces no error.
No Choros runtime code imports or reads egress_policy on day-1: grep -r 'egress_policy' src/ (excluding __tests__/, migrations/, ci/) returns 0 matches in any .ts file.
Migration seam: T-0041's commit adds ONLY files numbered 038 (and optionally 039); no file numbered 032-037 or 040+ is introduced.
Frozen foundations: data-classification.ts, grant-lattice.ts, grant-resolver.ts, object-handle.ts, and all pre-existing migration files are byte-unchanged; tsc --noEmit passes.

No dev-seed rows of 'allow all' form in migration 038/039; if any seed rows exist they are specific to a named test-tenant policy; if no seed rows, the table starts empty for the dev tenant (deny-by-default).
description column is nullable; a row with description = NULL is accepted.

The class column value in egress_policy is type-compatible with DataClass from src/core/data-classification.ts; a static TS type-level contract test asserts the egress_policy.class type is assignable to DataClass.
